verdict.rationale: telli documents a Live Monitoring page with a real-time call overview, dashboards for reach rate, duration and success rate, and per-call analysis of transcripts and outcomes. Real-time webhooks for call events, status changes and outcomes would let a platform engineer build their own alerting pipeline. There is no evidence of native alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes, so the alerting half of the story needs extra tooling. Missing for 10: native alerting or thresholds on error rates or anomalies, detection of agent misbehavior, depth on what Live Monitoring shows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
